title: Mini Pizza "Cupcakes"
description: These pizza "cupcakes" have a tasty garlic bread crust surrounding oozing cheese and any of your favorite pizza toppings--what a fun way to eat pizza!
ingredients: 0.75 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, or to taste
1 (6 ounce) package sliced pepperoni, or to taste
2 cups marinara sauce, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Spray a 24-cup mini muffin tin with cooking spray.

Roll pizza dough on a lightly floured surface into a 12x18-inch rectangle. Use a pizza cutter to slice dough into 24 squares. Place mozzarella cheese and pepperoni slices on each square; you'll need to be able to enclose the toppings in the dough so keep that in mind. Carefully lift up each square and wrap dough around toppings. Pinch to seal shut and place seam-side down in the prepared muffin cups.
Brush the tops of the dough balls with olive oil, then sprinkle with Italian seasoning and garlic powder. Top with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown on top, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat marinara sauce in a saucepan over medium-low heat.
Remove pizza "cupcakes" from the oven and serve with warm marinara on the side for dipping.
